_comment: Copy to trust-bundle.json and replace with your own release keys. The key below is a THROWAWAY EXAMPLE generated for this file; its private half was discarded and it signs nothing real. Keys whose PEM fails to parse are ignored (they can never verify), and any signer not listed in a policy fails signer_matches_policy even if its signature is cryptographically valid.
